So kommt PDFMy als App auf Ihr iPhone: 1: How to get PDFMy as an app on your iPhone: 1. In Safari, tap ‘Share’ at the bottom (square with an upward arrow). 2. Choose ‘Add to Home Screen’. 3. Tap ‘Add’ at the top right. PDFMy then starts like an app from the new icon.

So öffnet ein Doppelklick im Dateimanage: How to make a double-click in the file manager open every PDF in PDFMy: 1. Right-click a PDF → ‘Open with’ or ‘Open with other application’. 2. Choose ‘PDFMy’ and tick ‘Set as default’ or ‘Always use’.
So öffnet ein Doppelklick im Finder jede: How to make a double-click in Finder open every PDF in PDFMy: 1. In Finder, right-click (or Control-click) a PDF → ‘Get Info’. 2. Under ‘Open with’ choose ‘PDFMy’. 3. Click ‘Change All …’ and confirm.
